response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across various domains, including full-stack, embedded systems, and open-source projects. However, his background lacks direct experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator optimization, or hardware-software co-design, which are critical for this role. His strengths in performance-oriented development and tooling could be relevant, but the role's specialized requirements are not clearly met.
strengths: Strong track record in performance-sensitive development (e.g., low-latency apps in DLang, real-time systems).
Diverse technical expertise across languages (TypeScript, DLang, C/C++) and domains (web, embedded, AI tooling).
Proven ability to build and maintain complex systems (e.g., GISCollective, open-source contributions).
concerns: No direct experience with SoC/IP modeling or AI accelerator optimization, core to the role.
Lacks explicit background in SIMD/MIMD architectures or GPU workload analysis, preferred qualifications.
Mostly web/mobile/desktop development focus; limited evidence of hardware-level optimization work.
